newsitem.title: UK: LME copper around $2,400, zinc probes fresh highs.
newsitem.headline: LME copper around $2,400, zinc probes fresh highs.

text.p: COPPER - Straddling $2,400, slightly firmer ahead of July options declaration. Cash/threes steady at $120/$125 back. LME stocks up 1,750 tonnes.
ZINC - At new 6-3/4 year high, testing $1,450 resistance.
ALUMINIUM - Up $15 at $1,618 after late Tuesday gains.
NICKEL/ALLOY - Firmer. TIN/LEAD - Little changed at $635/637.
